bullets: Penalize large values of W (model parameters)
This has the effect of better generalization of the model

Since there is a contradiction between model training (using training dataset) and model generalization, the generalization term is added to the objective loss function with a customized weigh factor (do regularization to what extent)
Penalization may be applied on the Squared Norm of the Weight Vector This is called L₂ regularization (also known as Ridge Regularization)
Penalization may also be applied on the sum of Absolute values of the Weight Vector This is called L₁ regularization
Regularization is particularly important for Small number of samples (N) and Large vector Length (d)
